&nbsp;Job Position: Ticketing &amp; Reservation Manager&nbsp;

	Supervise and manage daily ticketing and reservation operations (Domestic &amp; International). Issue, re-issue, re-route, and process refunds in compliance with airline policies and IATA rules.

	Monitor and manage queues: Ticketing queues, schedule change, waitlist, SSR, and UN/NO queues.
	Oversee hotel reservations, car rentals, and ancillary services.
	Train, coach, and evaluate ticketing officers.
	Handle escalated ticketing issues and client complaints from Sales and Corporate clients.
	Liaise with airlines for special fares, group fares, seat confirmations, and waivers.
	Prepare daily sales reports, BSP reconciliation, and ticketing productivity reports.
	Ensure 24/7 support rotation for after-hours emergency ticketing.
	Keep team updated on airline promotions, new routes, travel regulations, and visa requirements.
	Ensure proper filing and documentation of tickets, PNRs, and refund records.

	B.Sc / HND in any discipline
	Compulsory: IATA / UFTAA Diploma in Travel &amp; Tourism or IATA Foundation in Travel &amp; Tourism
	Amadeus / Galileo / Sabre GDS Certification is mandatory
	Additional certification in Airline Ticketing is an advantage.


Experience:


	5 - 7 years of hands-on ticketing and reservation experience in a reputable travel agency.
	At least 2-3 years in a supervisory / managerial role managing a ticketing team.
	Proven experience in handling Corporate, First/Business Class, and complex international itineraries.
	Must have experience in BSP reporting and ADM resolution.
	Experience with LCCs (ValueJet, Air Peace, etc.) and international airlines (Emirates, Qatar, British Airways, etc.).


Skills / Competencies:&nbsp;


	Expert proficiency in at least one GDS: Amadeus is compulsory, Sabre/Galileo is an added advantage
	Strong knowledge of fare construction, fare basis, endorsements, and airline fare rules
	Excellent understanding of IATA regulations, BSP procedures, and ADM handling
	High attention to detail and accuracy - zero tolerance for error
	Strong leadership and people management skills
	Excellent customer service and problem-solving ability
	Good communication and interpersonal skills
	Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
	Proficiency in MS Excel and ticketing reports
	High level of integrity and accountability.


Renumeration &amp; Benefits


	Salary: Negotiable based on GDS expertise and experience
	Ticketing allowance / Performance incentive
	HMO, Pension, 13th Month
	Annual leave and travel benefits
	Professional training and GDS recertification support.


Method of Application&nbsp;

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Ticketing & Reservation Manager 

Job Location: Lagos

Responsibilties / Duties
     

            
    




	Supervise and manage daily ticketing and reservation operations (Domestic & International). Issue, re-issue, re-route, and process refunds in compliance with airline policies and IATA rules.
	Perform fare construction, quotation, and ticketing using GDS (Amadeus / Galileo / Sabre). Handle complex itineraries, multi-city bookings, group bookings, and special requests (UMNR, WCHR, excess baggage). Check and minimize ADM (Agency Debit Memo) and ensure 100% accuracy to avoid airline penalties.
	Monitor and manage queues: Ticketing queues, schedule change, waitlist, SSR, and UN/NO queues.
	Oversee hotel reservations, car rentals, and ancillary services.
	Train, coach, and evaluate ticketing officers.
	Handle escalated ticketing issues and client complaints from Sales and Corporate clients.
	Liaise with airlines for special fares, group fares, seat confirmations, and waivers.
	Prepare daily sales reports, BSP reconciliation, and ticketing productivity reports.
	Ensure 24/7 support rotation for after-hours emergency ticketing.
	Keep team updated on airline promotions, new routes, travel regulations, and visa requirements.
	Ensure proper filing and documentation of tickets, PNRs, and refund records.


Requirements
Education:


	B.Sc / HND in any discipline
	Compulsory: IATA / UFTAA Diploma in Travel & Tourism or IATA Foundation in Travel & Tourism
	Amadeus / Galileo / Sabre GDS Certification is mandatory
	Additional certification in Airline Ticketing is an advantage.


Experience:


	5 - 7 years of hands-on ticketing and reservation experience in a reputable travel agency.
	At least 2-3 years in a supervisory / managerial role managing a ticketing team.
	Proven experience in handling Corporate, First/Business Class, and complex international itineraries.
	Must have experience in BSP reporting and ADM resolution.
	Experience with LCCs (ValueJet, Air Peace, etc.) and international airlines (Emirates, Qatar, British Airways, etc.).


Skills / Competencies: 


	Expert proficiency in at least one GDS: Amadeus is compulsory, Sabre/Galileo is an added advantage
	Strong knowledge of fare construction, fare basis, endorsements, and airline fare rules
	Excellent understanding of IATA regulations, BSP procedures, and ADM handling
	High attention to detail and accuracy - zero tolerance for error
	Strong leadership and people management skills
	Excellent customer service and problem-solving ability
	Good communication and interpersonal skills
	Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
	Proficiency in MS Excel and ticketing reports
	High level of integrity and accountability.


Renumeration & Benefits


	Salary: Negotiable based on GDS expertise and experience
	Ticketing allowance / Performance incentive
	HMO, Pension, 13th Month
	Annual leave and travel benefits
	Professional training and GDS recertification support.

&nbsp;Job Position: Sales Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Sales Executive will be responsible for generating new business, acquiring customers, promoting the company&#39;s logistics services, and achieving agreed sales and revenue targets
	The role involves identifying potential clients, understanding their logistics needs, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on leads, and building strong, long-term customer relationships.
	Candidates with previous experience in the logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, courier, warehousing, distribution, or supply chain industry will have an added advantage.


Job Description


	The Sales Executive will actively promote the company&#39;s logistics and supply chain services to prospective and existing customers.
	The successful candidate will develop sales leads, conduct client visits, follow up on enquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate within approved guidelines, and convert prospects into paying customers.
	The role requires a proactive and target-driven individual who can identify sales opportunities and contribute to the company&#39;s overall revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new sales opportunities within the assigned market.
	Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, online platforms, client visits, and other sales activities.
	Promote the company&#39;s logistics, transportation, delivery, warehousing, freight, and distribution services.
	Contact prospective clients to understand their business and logistics requirements.
	Prepare quotations, proposals, presentations, and other sales documents.
	Follow up consistently on leads, enquiries, quotations, and proposals.
	Convert prospects into new customers and achieve agreed sales targets.
	Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
	Conduct client visits and sales presentations when required.
	Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and additional services.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, customers, quotations, and sales activities.
	Monitor customer feedback and work with relevant departments to resolve service-related issues.
	Keep up to date with market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
	Provide regular sales reports and updates to management.
	Attend networking events, exhibitions, and other business activities to generate leads and promote the company.
	Work closely with the Business Development, Operations, Customer Service, and Finance teams to ensure effective service delivery.
	Ensure all sales activities comply with company policies and procedures.
	Perform other duties as assigned by management.


Education


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, Economics, Management, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
	Relevant professional certification in Sales or Marketing is an added advantage.


Experience:


	4-5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or a related position.
	Proven experience in lead generation, customer acquisition, and achieving sales targets.
	Experience in B2B sales and corporate client management is an advantage.
	Experience preparing quotations, proposals, and sales presentations.
	Previous experience in logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, courier, warehousing, distribution, or supply chain will be an added advantage.
	Candidates with an established network of potential corporate clients will have an added advantage.


Required Skills:


	Strong sales and customer acquisition skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
	Ability to generate and convert leads.
	Target-driven and results-oriented approach.
	Good presentation and telephone communication skills.
	Strong customer service skills.
	Good problem-solving and follow-up skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Good organisational and time-management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/sales management tools.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet sales targets.


Requirements:


	Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets.
	Strong understanding of sales and customer acquisition processes.
	Ability to identify and develop new business opportunities.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
	Must be proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented.
	Logistics industry experience will be an added advantage.
	Willingness to travel for client meetings and sales activities when required.
	Ability to work with minimal supervision.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer focus.
	Must be comfortable with field sales and client visits.
	Must be available to resume within the required timeframe.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: dglhrexecutive@gmail.com using &ldquo;Sales Executive - Abuja&rdquo; as the subject of the email.

Sales Executive Job at DGL Limited




        
    

        
        At DGL Limited, we grow our clients’ businesses by listening to and understanding their needs, hence partnering with them to achieve their goals. We link manufacturers with numerous customers in over 100 cities and villages across Nigeria, getting their products to them seamlessly and rapidly.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Sales Executive will be responsible for generating new business, acquiring customers, promoting the company's logistics services, and achieving agreed sales and revenue targets
	The role involves identifying potential clients, understanding their logistics needs, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on leads, and building strong, long-term customer relationships.
	Candidates with previous experience in the logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, courier, warehousing, distribution, or supply chain industry will have an added advantage.


Job Description


	The Sales Executive will actively promote the company's logistics and supply chain services to prospective and existing customers.
	The successful candidate will develop sales leads, conduct client visits, follow up on enquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate within approved guidelines, and convert prospects into paying customers.
	The role requires a proactive and target-driven individual who can identify sales opportunities and contribute to the company's overall revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new sales opportunities within the assigned market.
	Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, online platforms, client visits, and other sales activities.
	Promote the company's logistics, transportation, delivery, warehousing, freight, and distribution services.
	Contact prospective clients to understand their business and logistics requirements.
	Prepare quotations, proposals, presentations, and other sales documents.
	Follow up consistently on leads, enquiries, quotations, and proposals.
	Convert prospects into new customers and achieve agreed sales targets.
	Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
	Conduct client visits and sales presentations when required.
	Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and additional services.
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, customers, quotations, and sales activities.
	Monitor customer feedback and work with relevant departments to resolve service-related issues.
	Keep up to date with market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
	Provide regular sales reports and updates to management.
	Attend networking events, exhibitions, and other business activities to generate leads and promote the company.
	Work closely with the Business Development, Operations, Customer Service, and Finance teams to ensure effective service delivery.
	Ensure all sales activities comply with company policies and procedures.
	Perform other duties as assigned by management.


Education


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, Economics, Management, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
	Relevant professional certification in Sales or Marketing is an added advantage.


Experience:


	4-5 years of experience in Sales, Business Development, or a related position.
	Proven experience in lead generation, customer acquisition, and achieving sales targets.
	Experience in B2B sales and corporate client management is an advantage.
	Experience preparing quotations, proposals, and sales presentations.
	Previous experience in logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, courier, warehousing, distribution, or supply chain will be an added advantage.
	Candidates with an established network of potential corporate clients will have an added advantage.


Required Skills:


	Strong sales and customer acquisition skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
	Ability to generate and convert leads.
	Target-driven and results-oriented approach.
	Good presentation and telephone communication skills.
	Strong customer service skills.
	Good problem-solving and follow-up skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Good organisational and time-management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/sales management tools.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet sales targets.


Requirements:


	Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets.
	Strong understanding of sales and customer acquisition processes.
	Ability to identify and develop new business opportunities.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
	Must be proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented.
	Logistics industry experience will be an added advantage.
	Willingness to travel for client meetings and sales activities when required.
	Ability to work with minimal supervision.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer focus.
	Must be comfortable with field sales and client visits.
	Must be available to resume within the required timeframe.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Sales Executive - Abuja” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
